title: refactor: incident-bot telemetry pipeline and oncall diagnostics helpers
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Improve observability and robustness of incident-bot's automated diagnostics and on-call helpers by refactoring the telemetry ingestion pipeline, normalizing diagnostic event schemas, and extracting shared helpers into slo-toolkit utilities. This reduces duplication between runbook linking, SLO correlation, and oncall summary features and makes telemetry enrichment more deterministic for downstream alerting and regression detection. Changes in this PR: 1) telemetry: introduce a lightweight event normalization step (telemetry/normalizer.go) to standardize fields used by runbooks and diagnostics (slo_id, incident_id, signal_source, anomaly_score, kv_context). 2) diagnostics: move common diagnostic reducers into slo-toolkit/helpers and update incident-bot to consume helpers for runbook scoring, quicklinks ranking, and suggested actions. 3) runbooks: add explicit runbook metadata enrichment (runbooks/enrichment.rs) for compact runbook views used in compact oncall messages. 4) tests: add e2e oncall simulation harness and telemetry-smoketests to catch regressions in enrichment logic. 5) rollout: feature-flag the new normalizer under `telemetry_normalizer_v2` and provide a safe rollback path. Backwards compatibility: Normalizer is opt-in via feature flag and falls back to existing enrichment logic if the normalized fields are missing, so this is not a breaking change. Checklist: - [x] Add normalizer and unit tests - [x] Extract helpers into slo-toolkit - [x] Update runbook enrichment and add contract tests - [x] Add telemetry-smoketests and e2e oncall simulation - [x] Feature-flag rollout and documented rollback steps Testing & verification: Unit tests cover normalization heuristics and helper APIs; integration tests validate the end-to-end enrichment path from telemetry event -> runbook suggestion -> quicklink ranking; e2e oncall simulation exercises high-throughput scenarios to validate batching and latency impact. CI: lint, unit, integration, and telemetry smoketests all passed on the branch. Rollout plan: Deploy to staging with feature flag enabled for internal SRE team for 48h, observe SLO-toolkit metrics and oncall flash reports, then enable gradually for 10% of prod traffic for 24h before full enablement. Rollback plan: disable `telemetry_normalizer_v2` feature flag and deploy a patch if errors exceed threshold. Related work: ENG-4512 (runbook enrichment improvements), SRE-3121 (telemetry normalization for diagnostics), SUP-8792 (customer-reported flaky quicklinks). Notes: Kept changes small in each file to aid review; most logic moved to slo-toolkit to be shared across incident-bot and other SRE tools. Requesting a squash merge once approved.
